name: Radial Blur v2
description: Transcendent depth-aware radial blur with anisotropic bokeh shape morphing driven by audio, Fibonacci sphere sampling, lens diffraction spikes on bright highlights, anamorphic streaks from mouse velocity, Sellmeier spectral dispersion on high-contrast edges, atmospheric haze on distant blur, dynamic mouse focus with depth-aware CoC, and adaptive sample count.
